great_hall.name: Great Hall
great_hall.description: Torches flicker on stone walls. The Stark direwolf banners hang above the high table.

courtyard.name: Training Yard
courtyard.description: Squires drill with wooden swords while ravens circle the towers.

godswood.name: Godswood
godswood.description: Heart trees and ancient oaks. Iron deposits glint beneath the roots. Wolves prowl the shadows.

mine_shaft.name: Northern Mine
mine_shaft.description: A cold mine cut into the bedrock beneath the castle. Deserters hide in the dark.

gatehouse.name: Gatehouse
gatehouse.description: Goldcloaks inspect wagons bound for the Kingsroad.

red_keep.name: Red Keep
red_keep.description: Marble halls and Lannister guards. The city roars beyond the walls.

flea_bottom.name: Flea Bottom
flea_bottom.description: Narrow alleys, taverns, and whispers of plots. Thieves lurk in every shadow.

royal_mint.name: Royal Mint
royal_mint.description: Gold coins stacked in vaults. Guards watch every scale.

blackwater_docks.name: Blackwater Docks
blackwater_docks.description: Ships unload grain and timber. Smugglers and dock raiders haunt the piers.

citadel_gate.name: Citadel Gate
citadel_gate.description: Maesters in grey chains pass scrolls between towers.

honeywine.name: Honeywine River
honeywine.description: Merchant barges and Tyrell grain shipments. Brigands stalk the riverbanks.

scriptorium.name: Scriptorium
scriptorium.description: Ancient tomes describe dragons, siegecraft, and lost houses. Cultists whisper in the stacks.

castle_black.name: Castle Black
castle_black.description: The Night's Watch gathers around a weirwood fire.

frozen_pass.name: Frozen Pass
frozen_pass.description: Beyond the Wall wind howls. Wildlings, wights, and worse roam the ice.

armory.name: Night's Watch Armory
armory.description: Black blades and obsidian daggers line the racks.
